questions.subject: MARKETING
questions.stem: Nightingale Footwear Co, a startup firm creates a genuinely new category with its Westmoor product, changing how people perform a task rather than slightly improving an existing item. What kind of innovation is this?
questions.explanation: A product that creates a new category and changes behaviour is a radical, or new-to-the-world, innovation. It carries high risk but can deliver large rewards. A line extension adds a variant to an existing line, an improvement is incremental, and a me-too product simply imitates competitors, none of which describes category creation.
questions.hint: Ask whether the product changes behaviour or merely tweaks an existing item.

options.misconception: mistakes a breakthrough for a copy of rivals
assumes a minor variation on an existing product
confuses a category-creating product with an incremental change
